description: Running wild horses and the rural life on the doorstep of 5th highest peak of Turkey called Erciyes mountain(3917). I always wanted to visit this place, so i made a tour and went to that rural life.it was wetland so that is why the ground was so muggy and slippery.it was fun to fly my drone over that wilderness.This area is over between Mount Erciyes Sindelhöyük and Cappadocia in the middle of Turkey. This land is one of the first settlements in human history.
